title: Bikini Atoll 2001-01-14, Landsat 7 ETM+, bands 3-2-1-8, rev2.png
author: NASA
credit: NASA Landsat satellite image GeoTIFF archive, http://glovis.usgs.gov
description: Composite "true color" multispectral satellite image of Bikini Atoll, Marshall Islands. NASA Landsat 7 ETM+ bands used were 3 (red), 2 (green) and 1 (blue), and the image was pan-sharpened to 15m resolution. Imagery courtesy of NASA/USGS.
